summary: "Fit to box" strands the four boxless views on a stale window
detail: shownWindow was only ever assigned inside applyBoxWindow, which runs only in the arp/penta/scale branches. Switching to Roots, Chord positions, CAGED triads or Triad inversions kept the last box's zoom: e.g. a penta box of frets 0-3 left CAGED triads drawing 6 of 25 dots on a 189-wide neck, with the legend still reading "box: frets 0-3".
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07. shownWindow is cleared at the top of computeFretData(). Verified: boxless views back to the full 520-wide neck with no box line, and the fit restored on return to penta.

summary: Any click on the page wipes the Root notes playback spotlight
detail: The document-level "release a pinned shape" listener called refreshShapeSpotlight(null) unconditionally, stripping shape-focus and every .hot - including the root ring renderFretboard paints for the sounding chord. Clicking a chord bar to audition it blanked the highlight until the root pitch class next changed.
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07. The listener returns early unless a shape is pinned; the root highlighting is extracted into paintRootSpotlight(), which refreshShapeSpotlight now calls alongside paintPositionsFollow. Verified: 8 root dots stay lit through a bar click and a stray click.

summary: Chord positions drew no grip outlines though the supporting code was still live
detail: The positions branch declared const lines = [] and never pushed to it. Meanwhile paintPositionsFollow still tagged .shape-line with pos-current/pos-next, and four CSS rules existed that could only match in this mode - all dead.
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07. Split out gripCells (the CAGED shape, or its 7th-chord voicing) and push one traced line per chord, tagged with the chord index. Verified: 3 outlines for 3 chords, taking the legend spotlight and the pos-current/pos-next follow tiers; kept when All chord tones or Voice leading is on.

summary: A pin the new key has no degree for showed as Random over a frozen chord
detail: transposeToKey cleared slotChoices[i] but left slotShapes[i], and transposeChord carried a stale _deg through Object.assign. Repro: A minor, slot 1 pinned to the harmonic-minor V (deg 7) with shape 7, switch to A major - the degree picker read Random while the bar still showed a fixed E7 and the shape picker still said 7.
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07. The harmonic-minor V is the only degree that can vanish, and its transposed root always lands on the new key's V, so transposeToKey re-pins it there and spells out its shape; transposeChord clears _deg/_shape. Verified: E7 -> E7 deg 4 in A major, G7 deg 4 in C major. Loaded genre progressions still transpose with numerals, bar lengths and 7ths intact.

summary: CAGED pentatonic colours notes with a box that is not on the neck
detail: The penta branch uses the unfiltered placements for owners (line ~682) and for cagedShapesShown (~665), while the box stepper gets placements.filter(onNeck) (~701). The scale branch filters in all three places and carries the comment explaining why. Verified A/B, chord C in C major: penta legend reads "D shape 0-1 . 9-13", scale reads "D shape 9-13" - the 0-1 run comes from a D@-2 box you cannot step to.

summary: A power-voiced rhythm has no dominant-7th grip and silently plays a full barre
detail: STYLE_TABLE.power has no '7' key, so voiceChord falls through to barre['7']. Swept all genre progressions x rhythms; one live case: Blues -> "Quick change in G" under "Shuffle riff (5-6)", where G7/C7/D7 are voiced and tabbed as six-string E/A-shape dominant barres at frets 3, 8 and 10 in a drive-toned riff meant to be power chords.

parseChordName's regex treats / as the slash-chord separator and the bass group only accepts [A-Ga-g], so "Cm/maj7" never parses. The mmaj7, minmaj7 and m(maj7) aliases still work, so no chord is actually unnameable.

summary: No BPM preset chip is highlighted at page load
detail: The tempo starts at 60 and a 60 chip exists, but the highlight is only applied in the tempo input's 'input' handler, which does not fire at load. A shared link does set it, because applyShareState dispatches the event.

summary: Measure readout flashes "1" for about 50 ms when count-in is off
detail: With the count-in off, playbackStartTime is still currentTime + 0.05, so syncHighlight's count-in branch is true for the first few frames and prints a clamped beat number.

summary: boxIndex and heldWindow persist across mode changes and re-rolls
detail: Neither is reset when the key changes or a new progression is rolled, so a held window from an old key can carry into an unrelated one. boxIndex is also shared between the arp, penta and scale views, which have different box counts. Arguably intended for Hold position; worth a decision either way.

summary: Preset variant highlight desyncs when the key leaves the variant's mode
detail: Choose Blues -> "Minor blues" (mode: minor), then switch to a major key: the progression stays but variantIdx still points at a minor-only variant, so no variant button is marked active.

summary: shownVoicings is assigned before its let declaration
detail: runChordFinder assigns shownVoicings at ~line 496; the let is at ~line 506. It works because the assignment only ever runs from an event handler after module load, but it is a TDZ trap for anyone who calls runChordFinder at load time.

summary: CAGED arpeggios traces the plain triad grip for a 7th chord
detail: The arp branch builds its outlines straight from cagedPlacements, so on a C7 it traces the open C major triad (x-3-2-0-1-0) rather than the C7 grip. CAGED triads passes the same placement through seventhCells and traces x-3-2-3-1-0, and marks the 7ths hollow. Verified on C7: the two modes' C-shape polylines differ at the third point (fret 0 vs fret 3), and arp draws 0 hollow dots to caged's 4. Found while investigating T4.
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07 as part of the T4 merge. The merged CAGED chords mode computes cagedTriadBoard once and uses its seventh-aware outlines for both readings, so the whole-arpeggio view traces the same grip as shape-only. Verified on C7: the two C-shape polylines are now identical (fret 3, the real open C7), where the arpeggio view previously traced fret 0.

summary: Chords single box jumped position when the chord changed
detail: boxIndex is an index into each chord's own sorted box list, and those lists differ per chord, so carrying the index across a chord change moved the hand. Repro (Jeff's): D-Em-Bm in D major, Chords + Single box + Other chords. With the A-shape Em at frets 7-9 in front, the "up next" ghost previewed a Bm at 7-9 (E shape), but selecting Bm jumped the window to 9-12 (D shape) - box index 3 means 7-9 for Em and 9-12 for Bm.
resolution: Fixed 2026-09-07. When the chord in front changes, the box is re-picked by position rather than by index: the new chord's box whose midpoint is nearest the window already on screen. Verified on the reported case - Em 7-9 -> Bm 7-9 -> D 7-10, the hand staying put across the whole progression, and the arrival now matching what the ghost previewed. Box stepping and Hold position are unaffected, as are the pentatonic and scale views.
